# FormatToSpaceWait

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Unpacks the registers of a WaitOn() on a space.

!!! info "Library helper"
    Implemented in `zuzu.h` on top of the syscalls; it has no syscall number of its own.

```c
SpaceWaitResult FormatToSpaceWait(SvcResult r);
```

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `r` | in | Result of WaitOn() on a space handle. |

## Returns

The status and the exit status of the space's last task.
